name: meojson
listed_description: Next-gen C++ JSON/JSON5 Serialization Engine | Zero Dependency | Header-Only | Unleash JSON Potential.
reason: No numeric comparison against any named baseline. Chinese and English READMEs make no performance claim; benchmark/benchmark.cpp only times meojson's own parser variants (none, bits32, bits64, simd128, simd256) with no other library; releases v4.3.2 to v5.1.2 carry no benchmark numbers; PR #80 'perf: AI' (merged 2026-07-04) has no before/after or baseline numbers; the library is not in miloyip/nativejson-benchmark's list of 43 libraries; web searches found no third-party shootout containing it.

name: qt-json
listed_description: A simple class for parsing JSON data into a QVariant hierarchy and vice versa.
reason: No numeric comparison anywhere reachable. README has no performance claim and says Qt5 users should use the native JSON classes; repository is archived (2026-03-31). The 'Qt' rows in miloyip/nativejson-benchmark measure Qt's own QJsonDocument, not gaudecker/qt-json; no third-party benchmark of this library turned up.
